m: धा f. in 2. तिरो-धा
दुर्-धा (qq.vv.)

1. धा cl. 3. P. Ā. दधाति, धत्ते, RV. &c. &c. (P. du. दध्वस्, धत्थस्, धत्तस् [Pāṇ. viii, 2, 38]; pl. दध्मसि or ˚मस्, धत्थ, दाधति; impf. अदधात् pl. ˚धुर्, 2. pl. अधत्त or अदधात, RV. vii, 33, 4; Subj. दधत् or ˚धात् [Pāṇ. vii, 3, 70, Kāś.], ˚धस्, ˚धतस्, ˚धन्; Pot. दध्यात्; Impv. दधातु, pl. ˚धतु; 2. sg. धेहि [fr. धद्धि; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 4, 119] or धत्तात्, RV. iii, 8, 1; 2. pl. धत्त, i, 64, 15, धत्तन, i, 20, 7, दधात, vii, 32, 13, or ˚तन, x, 36, 13 [cf. Pāṇ. vii, 1, 45, Sch.]; p. दधत्, ˚ति m. pl. ˚तस्; Ā. 1. sg. दधे [at once 3. sg. = धत्ते, RV. i, 149, 5 &c. and = pf. Ā.], 2. sg. धत्से, viii, 85, 5 or धत्से, AV. v, 7, 2; 2. 3. du. दधाथे, ˚धाते; 2. pl. ˚धिध्वे [cf. pf.]; 3. pl. दधते, RV. v, 41, 2; impf. अधत्त, ˚त्थास्; Subj. दधसे, viii, 32, 6 [Pāṇ. iii, 4, 96, Kāś.]; Pot. दधीत, RV. i, 40, 2 or दधीत, v, 66, 1; Impv. 2. sg. धत्स्व, x, 87, 2 or दधिष्व, iii, 40, 5 &c.; 2. pl. धद्ध्वम् [Pāṇ. viii, 2, 38, Kāś.] or दधिध्वम्, RV. vii, 34, 10, &c.; 3. pl. दधताम्, AV. viii, 8, 3; p. दधान); rarely cl. 1. P. Ā. दधति, ˚ते, RV.; MBh.; only thrice cl. 2. P. धाति, RV.; and once cl. 4. Ā. Pot. धायेत, MaitrUp. (pf. P. दधौ, ˚धाथ, ˚धतुर्, ˚धिमा or ˚धिम, ˚धुर्, RV. &c.; Ā. दधे [cf. pr.], दधिषे or धिषे, RV. i, 56, 6; 2. 3. du. दधाथे, ˚धाते, 2. pl. दधिध्वे [cf. pr.]; 3. pl. दधिरे, दध्रे, x, 82, 5; 6, or धिरे, i, 166, 10 &c.; p. दधान [cf. pr.]; aor. P. अधात्, धात्, धास्; अधुर्, धुर्, RV. &c.; Pot. धेयाम्, ˚युर्; धेतन, RV.; TBr.; 2. sg. धायीस्, RV. i, 147, 5; Impv. धातु [cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 8 Vārtt. 3; Pat.]; 2. pl. धात or ˚तन, 3. pl. धान्तु, RV.; Ā. अधित, ˚थास्, अधीताम्, अधीमहि, धीमहि, धीमहे, धामहे, RV.; 3. sg. अहित, हित, AV.; TĀr.; Subj. धेथे, RV. i, 158, 2, धैथे, vi, 67, 7; Impv. धिष्वा or धिष्व, ii, 11, 18, &c.; P. अधत्, SV.; धत्, RV.; P. धासुर् Subj. ˚सथस् and ˚सथ, RV.; Ā. अधिषि, ˚षत, Br.; Pot. धिषीय, ib. [Pāṇ. vii, 4, 45]; धेषीय, MaitrS.; fut. धास्यति, ˚ते or धाता, Br. &c.; inf. धातुम्, Br. &c.; Ved. also ˚तवे, ˚तवै, ˚तोस्; धियध्यै, RV.; Class. also -धितुम्; ind.p. धित्वा, Br.; हित्वा [Pāṇ. vii, 4, 42], -धाय and -धाम्, AV. : Pass. धीयते, RV. &c. [Pāṇ. vi, 4, 66], p. धीयमान, RV. i, 155, 2 ; aor. अधायि, धायि, RV. [Pāṇ. vii, 3, 33, Kāś.]; Prec. धासीष्ट or धायिषीष्ट [vi, 4, 62]) to put, place, set, lay in or on (loc.), RV. &c. &c. (with दण्डम्, to inflict punishment on [with loc. MBh. v, 1075, with gen. R. v, 28, 7]; with तत्-पदव्याम् पदम्, to put one's foot in another's footstep i.e. imitate, equal, Kāvyād. ii, 64); to take or bring or help to (loc. or dat.; with आरे, to remove), RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; (Ā.) to direct or fix the mind or attention (चिन्ताम्, मनस्, मतिम्, समाधिम् &c.) upon, think of (loc. or dat.), fix or resolve upon (loc. dat. acc. with प्रति or a sentence closed with इति), RV.; Mn.; MBh.; Kāv.; BhP.; to destine for, bestow on, present or impart to (loc. dat. or gen.), RV.; Br.; MBh. &c. (Pass. to be given or granted, fall to one's [dat.] lot or share, RV. i, 81, 3); to appoint, establish, constitute, RV.; ŚBr.; to render (with double acc.), RV. vii, 31, 12; Bhartṛ. iii, 82; to make, produce, generate, create, cause, effect, perform, execute, RV.; TBr.; ŚvetUp. &c. (aor. with पूरयाम्, मन्त्रयाम्, वरयाम् &c. = पूरयाम् &c. चकार); to seize, take hold of, hold, bear, support, wear, put on (clothes), RV.; AV.; Kāv.; BhP. &c.; (Ā.) to accept, obtain, conceive (esp. in the womb), get, take (with ओकस् or चनस्, to take pleasure or delight in [loc. or dat.]), RV.; AV.; Br.; to assume, have, possess, show, exhibit, incur, undergo, RV.; Hariv.; Kāv.; Hit. etc. : Caus. -धापयति, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 36 (see अन्तर्-धा, श्रद्-धा &c.) : Desid. धित्सति, ˚ते (Pāṇ. vii, 4, 54), to wish to put in or lay on (loc.), RV.; AitBr. (Class. Pass. धित्स्यते; धित्स्य, see s.v.); दिधिषति, ˚ते, to wish to give or present, RV.; (Ā.) to wish to gain, strive after (p. दिधिषाण, x, 114, 1), ib. : with अवद्यम्, to bid defiance, ib. iv, 18, 7 (cf. दिधिषाय्य, दिधिषु) : Intens. देधीयते, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 66.
धा [cf. Zd. dā, dadaiti; Gk. θε-, θη-, τίθημι; Lith. dedù, dë́ti; Slav. dedją, děti; Old Sax. duan, dôn, Angl.Sax. dôn, Engl. to do; Germ. tuan; tuon, thun.]
2. धा mfn. putting, placing, bestowing, holding, having, causing &c. (ifc.; cf. 2. ध)
धा m. placer, bestower, holder, supporter &c.
N. of Brahmā or Bṛhas-pati, L.
धा (आ), f. See 2. ध
instr. (= nom.) perhaps in the suffix धा (which forms adverbs from numerals, e.g. एक-धा, द्वि-धा &c.)
a: धा — {c3c} U. (दधाति, धत्ते, दधौ-दधे, अधात्-अधित, धास्यति-ते, धातुं, हित; pass. धीयते; caus. धापयति-ते; desid. धित्सति-ते) 1 To put, place, set, lay, put in, lay on or upon; विज्ञातदोषेषु दधाति दंडं Mb.; निःशंकं धीयते (v. l. for दीयते) लोकैः पश्य भस्मचये पदं H. 2. 173. --2 To fix upon, direct (the mind or thoughts &c.) towards (with dat. or loc.); धत्ते चक्षुर्मुकुलिनि रणत्कोकिले बालचूते Māl. 3. 12; दधुः कुमारानुगमे मनांसि Bk. 3. 11, 2. 7; Ms. 12. 23. --3 To bestow anything upon one, grant, give, confer, present; (with dat., gen., or loc.); धुर्यां लक्ष्मीमथ मयि भृशं धेहि देव प्रसीद Māl. 1. 3; यद्यस्य सोऽदधात्सर्गे तत्तस्य स्वयमाविशत् Ms. 1. 29. --4 To hold, contain; तानपि दधासि मातः Bv. 1. 68; Ś. 4. 3. --5 To seize, take hold of (as in the hand); Bk. 1. 26, 4. 26; Ki. 13. 54. --6 To wear, put on, bear; गुरूणि वासांसि विहाय तूर्णं तनूनि… धत्ते जनः काममदालसांगः Rs. 6. 13, 16; धत्ते भरं कुसुमपत्रफलावलीनां Bv. 1. 94; दधतो मंगलक्षौमै R. 12. 8, 9. 40; Bk. 17. 54. --7 To assume, take, have, show, exhibit, possess; (usually Atm.); काचः कांचनसंसर्गाद्धत्ते मारकतीं द्युतिं H. Pr. 41; शिरसि मसीपटलं दधाति दीपः Bv. 1. 74; R. 2. 7; Amaru. 23. 67; Me. 36; Bh. 3. 46; R. 3. 1; Bk. 2. 1; 4. 16, 18; Śi. 9. 3, 10. 86; Ki. 5. 5. --8 To hold up, sustain, bear up; गामधास्यत्कथं नागो मृणालमृदुभिः फणैः Ku. 6. 68. --9 To support, maintain संपद्विनिमयेनोभौ दधतुर्भुवनद्वयं R. 1. 26. --10 To cause, create, produce, generate, make; मुग्धा कुड्मलिताननेन दधती वायुं स्थिता तत्र सा Amaru. 70. --11 To suffer, undergo, incur; Śi. 9. 2, 32, 66. --12 To perform, do --13 Ved. To bring, convey. --14 To appoint, fix. [The meanings of this root, like those of दा, are variously modified according to the word with which it is connected; e. g. मनः, मतिं, धियं, &c. धा to fix the mind or thoughts upon, resolve upon; पदं धा to set foot on, to enter; कर्णे करं धा to place the hand on the ear &c.]. --WITH अपि (the अ being sometimes dropped) {1} (a) to close, shut; ध्वनति मधुपसमूहे श्रवणमपिदधाति Gīt. 5; so कर्णौ-नयने-पिदधाति. (b) to cover, hide, conceal; प्रायो मूर्खः परिभवविधौ नाभिमानं पिधत्ते Ś. Til. 17 v. l. प्रभावपिहिता V. 4. 2; Śi. 9. 76; Bk. 7. 69. {2} to hinder, obstruct, bar; भुजंगपिहितद्वांर पातालमधितिष्ठति R. 1. 80. (The following verse illustrates the use of धा with some prepositions:--अधित कापि मुखे सलिलं सखी प्यधित कापि सरोजदलैः स्तनौ . व्यधित कापि हृदि व्यजनानिलं न्यधित कापि हिमं सुतनोस्तनौ N. 4. 111; or, better still, the following verse of Jagannātha:--निधानं धर्माणां किमपि च विधानं नवमुदां प्रधानं तीर्थानाममलपरिधानं त्रिजगतः . समाधानं बुद्धेरथ खलु तिरोधानमधियां श्रियामाधानं नः परिहरतु तापं तव वपुः .. G. L. 18).

। annatyAge brate Bakzyametadeva vivarjayet” pAdmottaraKaRqam । DAnyamAnantu hemA॰ dA॰ uktaM yaTA BavizyapurARe “paladvayantu prasftaM dviguRaM kuqavaM matam । caturBiH kuqavEH prasTaH prasTAScatvAra AQakaH । AQakEstEScaturBiSca droRastu kaTitobuDEH । kumBo droRadvayaM sUrpaH KArI droRAstu zoqaSa” । vizRuDarmottare “palaYca kuqavaH prasya AQako droRa eva ca । DAnyamAnezu bodDavyAH kramaSo'mI caturguRAH । droREH zoqaSamiH KArI viMSatyA kumBa ucyate । kumBEstu daSaBirvADo DAnyasaMKyA prakIrttitA” । vArAhapurARe “paladvayantu prasftam muzwirekaM palaM smftam । azwamuzwi rBavet kuYciH kuYcayo'zwO tu puzkalam । puzkalAni ca catvAri AQakaH parikIrttitaH । caturAQako Bavet droRa ityetanmAnalakzaRam । caturBiH setikABistu prasTa ekaH prakItitaH” muzwiryajamAnasyeti kecit । pAdme “caturBiH kuqavEH prasTaH prasTEScaturBirAQakaH । caturAQako BavedroRa ityetanmAnalakzaRam” । aTa gopaTabrAhmaRe । “paYcakfzRalako mAzastEScatuHzazwiBiH palam । palErdvAtriMSadBiHprasTo mAgaDezu prakIrttitaH । AdakastEHScaturBiSca droRaH syAccaturAQakaH” । DAnyacCedanAdivihitanakzatrAdi jyo॰ da॰ uktaM dIpikAyAM “yAmyAjapAdahiDanAnalatoyaSakracitretarezu ca kujArkajavAravarjam । SastenduyogakaraRezutiTO virikte vAnyacCidiH sTiranararkzamfgodayezu । balaBadraH “revatIhastamUlezu SravaRe nAgayAmyayoH । pitfdeve taTA sOmye DAnyacCedaM mfgodaye” aTa DAnyacCedanaprakAraH । “sapatrO mAsamudgO ca yavaDAnye sakARqake । CindyAttilaYca nizpatrametat pArASaraM matam” parASaraH । “na muzwigrahaRaM kuryAt kadAcidDawapOzayoH । ISAne lavanaM kuryAt sArdDamuzwidvayaM SuciH । pOzRe puzye SuBAhe bA pUjayitvezwadevatAm । SasyaviGnapraSAntyarTaM kzetre vA havya Bojanam” । bODAyanaH “raTASvagajaDAnyAnAM gavAM cEva rajaH SuBam । aTASastaM samUhinyAH SvAjAviKara vAyasAm” । samUhinI saMmArjanI । kftyacintAmaROmeDiruktA yaTA । “vawaSca saptaparRaSca gAmBArI SAllI taTA OdumbarI taTA DAtrI yA cAnyA kzIraDAriRI । strInAmnI karzakErnityaM meDiH kAryA PalapradA” । aDikaM kfziSabde dfSyam ।
m: 1. धान्य mfn. consisting or made of grain, RV.; AV.
धान्य n. corn, grain, ib. &c. &c. (according to Suśr. only शालयः, षष्टिकाः & व्रीहयः, the other grains being कु-धान्य, q.v.)
a measure = 4 sesamum seeds, L.
coriander (also f(आ). ), L.
Cyperus Rotundus, L.
a kind of house, Gal.
2. धान्य n. (fr. धन) the being rich, richness, Dhātup. xx, 3.
a: धान्यं — [धाने पोषणे साधु यत्] 1 Graint corn, rice; (for the distinction between सस्य, धान्य, तंडुल and अन्न see under तंडुल). --2 Coriander. --3 A measure equal to four sesamum seeds. --Comp. --अचलः a pile of grain presented to, Brāhmaṇas as a gift. --अरिः a mouse, rat. --अर्थः wealth in rice or grain --अम्लं sour gruel made of the fermentation of rice-water. --अस्थि n. husk, chaff. --उत्तमः the best of grain, i. e. rice. --कल्कं {1} bran. {2} chaff, straw. --कोशः, --कोष्ठकं --कः a granary. --क्षेत्रं a corn-field. --चमसः rice flattened by threshing after it has been steeped and fried in the husk. --त्वच् f. the husk of corn. --मायः a corn-dealer. --राजः barley. --वर्धनं lending grain at interest, usury with grain. --वीजं (बीजं) coriander. --वीरः a sort of pulse (माष). --शीर्षकं the ear of corn. --शूकं the beard or awn of corn. --सारः threshed corn.

k.v: किंशारुः सस्यशूकं स्यात्कणिशं सस्यमञ्जरी। धान्यं व्रीहिः स्तम्बकरिः स्तम्बो गुच्छस्तृणादिनः॥

s: strI, (DAnyanirmmitA DenuH .) dAnArTaDAnyanirmmitaDenuH । yaTA, -- “vizuve cAyane vApi kArttikyAntu viSezataH । tadidAnIM pravakzyAmi DAnyaDenuviDiM param ॥ yAM dattvA sarvvapApeByaH SaSANka iva rAhutaH ॥ daSaDenupradAnena yat PalaM rAjasattama ! । tat sarvvamevamApnoti vrIhiDenuprado naraH ॥ kfzRAjinaM tataH kftvA prAgvadvat saMnyasedbuDaH । gomayenAnuliptAyAM SoBanAM vastrasaMyutAm ॥ pUjayedvedimaDye tu vedanirGozamaNgalEH ॥ uttamA DAnyaDenuH syAddroRaScApi catuzwayEH । maDyamA ca tadardDena vittaSAWyaM na kArayet ॥ caturTAMSena DenvA vE vatsantu parikalpayet । karttavye rukmaSfNge tu rAjatakzurasaMyutA ॥ goruDaH pUrvvavadGrARamaguruYcandanantaTA । muktAPalamayA dantA GftakzOdramayaM muKam ॥ praSastapatraSravaRA kAMsyadohanakAnvitA । ikzuyazwimayAH pAdAH kzOmapucCasamanvitA ॥ nAnAPalasamopetA ratnagarBasamanvitA । pAdukopAnahO Catre BAjanaM tarpaRaM taTA ॥ ityevaM racayitvA tAM kftvA dIpArccanAdikam । puRyakAlaYca saMprApya snAtaH SuklAmbaro gfhI । triH pradakziRamAvftya mantreRAnena kIrttayet ॥ tava vipra ! mahABAga ! vedavedANgapAraga ! । yAmetAYca mayA dattAM gfhRIzva tvaM dvijottama ! । prIyatAM mama deveSo BagavAnmaDusUdanaH ॥ tvamekA lakzmIrgovinde svAhA yA ca viBAvasO । Sakre SacIti viKyAtA meDA munizu sattama ! ॥ tasmAt sarvvamayI devI DAnyarUpeRa saMsTitA । evamuccAryya tAM DenuM brAhmaRAya nivedayet ॥ dattvA pradakziRaM kftvA taM samApya dvijottamam । yAvacca pfTivI sarvvA vasuratnAni BUpate ! । tAvat puRyaM samADikyaM vrIhiDenoSca tat Palam ॥ tasmAnnarendra ! dAtavyA BuktimuktiPalapradA । iha loke ca sOBAgyamAyurArogyavardDanam ॥ vimAnenArkavarRena kiNkiRIratnamAlinA । stUyamAno'psaroBiSca prayAti Sivamandiram ॥ yAvacca smarate janma tAvat svarge mahIyate । tataH svargAt pariBrazwo jambudvIpapatirBavet ॥ evaM hareRa codgIrRaM SrutvA vAkyaM narottama । sarvvapApaviSudDAtmA rudraloke mahIyate ॥” iti varAhapurARam ॥

v: pu॰ dAnArTakalpite DAnyamaye parvate tadviDAnAdi hemA॰ dA॰ padmapu॰ uktaM yaTA । “tasmAdviDAnaM vakzyAmi parvatAnAmanuttamam । praTamo DAnyaSElaH syAt dvitIyo lavaRAcalaH । guqAcalastftIyastu caturTo hemaparvataH । paYcamastilaSElaH syAt zazWaH kArpAsaparvataH । saptamo GftaSElaSca ratnaSElastaTA'zwamaH । rAjato navamastadvaddaSamaH SarkarAcalaH । vakzye viDAna metezAM yaTAvadanupUrvaSaH । ayane vizuve cEva vyatIpAte dinakzaye । Suklapakze tftIyAyAmuparAge SaSikzaye! vivAhotsavayajYe vA dvAdaSyAmaTa vA punaH । SuklAyAM paYcadaSyAM vA puRyarkze ca viDAnataH । DAnyaSElAdayo deyA yaTASradDaM viDAnataH । tIrTe vAyatane vApi gozWe vApi BavANgaRe । maRqapaM kArayedBaktyA caturasramudaNmuKam । prAgudakpravaRaM tadvatprANmuKaM vA viDAnataH” । maRqapalakzaRantu, pariBAzAyAM pratipAditam । atra cAyaM viDAnakramaH dAnadivasAt pUrvedyuH pUrvAhRe kfta snAnAdikriyo yajamAnaH amukaparvatadAnamahaM SvaH karizye iti kftasaMkalpo vfdDiSrAdDamAByudayakaM viDAya pUrvavat puRyAhavAcanaM kuryyAt, tadanantaram adya amukaspin deSe amukasmin kAle amukaparvatadAnenAhaM yakzye tatra tadaNgaBUtahomAdike amukaSarmARaM amukavedADyAyinam ftvijaM tvAmahaM dfRe iti । purARavedavidAYcaturRAmftvijAM varaRaM, taTA om adya amukasmin deSe amukasmin kAle amukaparvatadAnenAhaM yakzye tatra tadaNgaBUtAni karmARi kartuM kArayituM ca amukagotraM amukaSarmARaM amukavedADyAyinaM guruM tvAmahaM vfRe ityAcAryaM vfRuyAt Gfto'smIti sarvatra prativacanaM tatra tAvat maDuparkeRArccayeditisarvaparvatadAnasADAraRo'yaM viDiH । “gomayenopaliptAyAM BUmAvAstIryya vE kuSAn । tanmaDye parvataM kuryAt vizkamBaparvatAnvitam । DAnyadroRasahasreRa BavedgiririhottamaH । BaDyamaH paYcaSatikaH kanizWaH syAt triBiH SatEH” । droRalakzaRamuktaM pariBAzAyAm । pramARasTakaracaraRasya puMso dvAdaSaBiH prasftiBiH kuqavo Bavati anena kuqavena catugurRottaraM prasTAQakadroRA Bavanti ataH catuHzazwyA kuqavErdroRo BavatIti kalpataruRA vyAKyAtam । “merurmahAbrIhimayastu maDye suvarRavfkzatrayamaMyutaH syAt । pUrveRa muktAPalavajrayukto yAmyena gomedakapuzparAgEH । paScAcca gArutmatanIlaratnEH sOmyena vEdUryasarojarAgEH । SrIKaRqaKaRqEraBitaH pravAlalatAnvitaH SuktiSilAtalaH syAt । brahmA'Ta vizRurBagavAn purArirdivAkaro'pyatra hiraRmayaH syAt । mUrdDavyavasTA gatamatsareRa kAryAH suvarRena taTA dvijOGAH । catvAri SfNgARi ca rAjatAni nitambaBAgezvapi rAjataH syAt । ArdrekzuvaMSAvftakandarastu GftodakaH prasravaRaSca dikzu । SuklAmbarARyambuDarAvalI syAt pUrveRa pItAni ca dakziRena । vAsAMsi paScAdaTa karvurARi raktAni cEbottaratoGanAlI । rOpyAnmahendrapramuKAnaTAzwO saMsTApya lokADipatIn krameRa । nAnAPalAlI ca samantataH syAt manoramaM mAlyavilepanaM ca । vitAnakaM copari paYcavarRamamlAnapuzpABaraRaM sitaYca” । merurityAdi, mahAvrIhayo, rAjAnnaSAlayaH, vfkzatrayasaMyuta, iti dakziRe mandAraH, uttare pArijAto, maDye kalpataruriti vfkzatrayaM, taTA pUrvato haricandanaM, paScime santAna iti tarudvayaM ca kuryAt, ete sarvaparvatezu karttavyA iti SarkarAcale vakzyamARatvAt sarvezAYca paYcaSAKatvamavaDeyamiti । vajraM, hIrakaM । gArutmataM, marakataM । sarojarAgaH, padmarAgaH । muktAPalAdoni ca yaTAdiSaM vakzyamARarAjataSfNgezu niveSanIyAni । purAriH, maheSvaraH । brahmAdilakzaRamuktaM brahmARqadAne । mUrdDavyavasTA uparideSasTitAH । gatamatsareRa, vittaSAWyarahitena । dvijOGAH, pakzisamUhAH । divISA iti kvacitpAWaH । tatra AdityAvasavorudrA divISAH । tezu, vasvAdilakzaRamuktaM brahmARqadAne, rudralakzaRaM viSvacakre । ikzureva vaMSaH, GftamevodakaM, vastrARyeva meGasamUhAH karvurARi, citrARi । lokapAlalakzaRamuktaM brahmARqadAne । “itTaMniveSyAmaraSElamagryaM meroSca vizkamBagirIn krameRa । turIyaBAgeRa caturddiSantu saMsTApayet puzpavilepanAwyAn । pUrveRa mandaramanekakalESca yuktaM yuktaM gaREH kanakaBadrakadambacihnam । kAmena kAYcanamayena virAjamAnamAkArayet kusumavastravilepanAQyam । kzIrAruRodasarasA'Ta vanena cEva rOpyeRa SaktiGawitena virAjamAnam । yAmyena ganDamadanaSca niveSanIyo goDUmasaYcayamayaH kalaDOtajambA । hEmena yakzapatinA GftamAnasena vastrESca rAjatavanena ca saMyutaH syAt । paScAttilAcalamanekasuganDipuzpasOvarRa pippala-hiraRmayahaMsayuktam । AkArayedrajatapuzpavanena tadvadvasvanvitaM daDisitodasarastaTAgre । saMsTApya taM vipulaSElamaTottareRa SElaM supArSvamapi mAzamayaM savastram । puzpESca hemavawapAdapaSeKarantamAkArayetkanakaDenuvirAjamAnam । mAkzIkaradrasarasA ca vanena tadvadrOpyeRa BAskaravatA ca yutaM viDAya” । itTanniveSyetyAdi, evaM meruM niveSya taccaturTaBAgaparimetena pfTagdravyeRa ekEkaM vizkamBagiriM kuryAt na tu cagurTaBAgena caturo'pIti, taTAca lavaRAcale vakzyati “caturTAMSena vizkamBaparvatAn kArayet, pfTagiti” । pUrveRa mandaramiti, sanniDAnAnmandaro'pi vrIhimaya eva, gaREryuktamiti, puruzAkftigaRatrayAnvitamityarTaH । anekaPalAlIyuktaM yavEriti kvacitpAWaH । tasya samUlatve yavAnuzWAnamapi kAryam । kanakaGawitena BadrakadambAKyena vfkzeRa lakzitam । kAmalakzaRamAha viSvakarmA “cApavARaDaraH kAmo ratipreyAn sumaDyamaH । AlIQo nandanI vAjI cApavAn viSvamAdakaH” iti । kzIrapUritena, aruRodasaMjYitena rUpyaGawitena, sarasA vanenApi rUpyaGawitena virAjamAnamiti sambanDaH । yAmyenetyAdi, ganDamadano, ganDamAdanaH, kalaDOtajaM yeti, suvarRajambuvfkzeRa । yakzapatirUpamuktaM SrIpraSne “hrasvamApiNgAkzaYca gadinaM pItavigraham । puzpakasTanDanADyakzaM DyAyet SivasaKaM sadeti” । GftamAnaseneti GftapUritena mAnasABiDAnena rAjatena sarasA । paScAditi, paScimadeSe daDipUritasitodaM nAma rajatanirmitaM sara iti, vipulaSElaM, vipulaM nAma parvataM mAkzIkaBadrasaraseti, mAkzIkaM, maDu tatpUritena rajatamayena BadrABiDAnena sarasA yutamityarTaH । atra ca kAmadevasya pratyaNmuKatvaM haMsasya prANmuKatvaM kanakaDenordakziRAmuKatvaM yakzapaterudaNmuKatvaM ca SarkarAcalasTitadigviSezApekzyaM dEvatezu sarvaSElezu veditavyaM, caramavyavasTA kuto'pi SAstrAdvyavasTitiriti । ete ca kAmadevAdayaH kadambAdInAM nijaparvatavfkzARAmaDastAtkarttavyAH । “homEScaturBiraTa vedapurARavidBirdAntEranindyacaritAkftiBirdvijendrEH । pUrveRa hastamitamatra viDAya kuRqaM kAryastilEryavaGftena samitkuSESca । rAtrO ca jAgaramanudDatagItatUryErAvAhanaYca kaTayAmi SiloccayAnAm” । pUrveRetyAdi maRqapasya pUrvaBAge hastamAtraM kuRqaM viDAya tasya pUrvottaradigvimAge tulApuruzoktalakzaRAM devatAvediM kftvA tatra vinAyakAdidevatAByaH pUrbavat pUjAM vidaDyAt anantaramftvijA'gnisTApanAnte grahARAM lokapAlAnAmityAdivakzyamARa devatAByastattalliNgamantrEstilAdidravyeRa homaM kuryuH । “sahasre tvaTa hotavye kuryAt kuRqaM karAtmakam” ityukteratra hastaparimitakuRqopadeSAdAhutisahasraM hotavyamiti dAnavivekakAraH । atra vinAyakAdayo dvAtriM SaddevA, dvAdaSAdityAH, ekAdaSarudrAH, daSa lokapAlAH, azwO vasavaH, brahma--vizRu--SivasUryAScatvAraH kAma Danada--haMsa--kAmaDenava ScatvAraH ityevamekASItisaMKyakeByo deveByaH grahAdInAM pratidEvataM trayodaSAhutihome tripaYcASadaDikamAhutisahasraM sampadyate । azwaSatantu hotavyamiti brahmARqapurARe vakzyati । tilAdIni catvAryeva havirdravyARi GftAktAnItyavagantavyam । samiDaH, sADAraRyAdudumbarasya । homAdanantaraM puzpopahArAnAdAya vakzyamARamantrEryaTAkramaM parvatAnAvAhayet, tatra merorAvAhanamantraH । “tvaM sarvadevagaRaDAmaniDe! virudDamasmadgfhe'pyamaraparvata! nASayASu । kzemaM viDatsva kuruSAntimanuttamAM naH sampUjitaH paramaBaktimatA mayA hi । tvameva BagavAnISo brahmA vizRurddivAkaraH । mUrttAmUrttaparaM vIjamataH pAhi sanAtanaH । yasmAttvaM lokapAlAnAM viSvamUrtteSca mandiram । rudrAdityavasUnAYca tasmAcCAntiM m: 1. धारा f. stream or current of water

(cf. त्रि-, द्वि-, शत-, सहस्र-), flood, gush, jet, drop (of any liquid), shower, rain (also fig. of arrows, flowers, &c.; वसोर् ध्˚, ‘source of good’, N. of a partic. libation to Agni, AV.; ŚBr.; MBh.; of a sacred bathing-place, MBh.; of Agni's wife, BhP.)
a leak or hole in a pitcher &c., L.
the pace of horse, Śiś. v, 60 (5 enumerated, viz. धोरित, वल्गित, प्लुत, उत्-तेजित, उत्-तेरित, or आ-स्कन्दित, रेचित for the two latter, L.; with परमा, the quickest pace, Kathās. xxxi, 39)
uniformity, sameness (as of flowing water?), L.
custom, usage, W.
continuous line or series (cf. वन-)
fig. line of a family, L.
N. of a sacred bathing-place (also with माहेश्वरी cf. above), MBh.
of a town (the residence of Bhoja), Cat.
2. धारा f. (√ 2. धाव्) margin, sharp edge, rim, blade (esp. of a sword, knife, &c.; fig. applied to the flame of fire), RV.; ŚBr.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the edge of a mountain, L.
the rim of a wheel, Ragh. xiii, 15
the fence or hedge of a garden, L.
the van of an army, L.
the tip of the ear, L.
highest point, summit (cf. ˚राधिरूढ) glory, excellence, L.
night, L.
turmeric, L.
a: धारा — 1 A stream or current of water, a line of descending fluid, stream, current; Bh. 2. 93; Me. 55; R. 16. 66; आबद्धधारमश्रु प्रावर्तत Dk. 74. --2 A shower, a hard or sharp-driving shower. --3 A continuous line or series; Bv. 2. 20. --4 A leak or hole in a pitcher. --5 The pace of a horse; धाराः प्रसाधयितुमव्यतिकीर्णरूपाः Śi. 5. 60. --6 The margin, edge or border of anything; ध्रुवं स नीलोत्पलपत्रधारया शमीलतां छेत्तुमृषिर्व्यबस्यति Ś. 1. 18. --7 The sharp edge of a sword, axe, or of any cutting instrument; तर्जितः परशुधारया मम R. 11. 78; 6. 42; 10. 86, 41; Bh. 2. 28. --8 The edge of a mountain or precipice. --9 A wheel or the periphery of a wheel; R. 13. 15. --10 A garden-wall, fence, hedge. --11 The van or front line of an army. --12 The highest point, excellence --13 A multitude. --14 Fame. --15 Night. --16 Turmeric. --17 Likeness. --18 The tip of the ear. --19 Speech. --20 Rumour, report. --Comp. --अग्रं the broad-edged head of an arrow. --अंकुरः {1} a drop of rain. {2} hail. {3} advancing before the line of an army (to defy the enemy). --अंगः a sword. --अटः {1} the Cātaka bird. {2} a horse. {3} a cloud. {4} a furious elephant, one in rut. --अधिरूढ a. raised to the highest pitch. --अवनिः f. wind. --अश्रु n. a flood of tears; Amaru. 10. --आसारः a heavy down-fall of rain, a hard or sharp driving shower; धारासारैर्महती वृष्टिर्बभूव H. 3; V. 4. 1. --उष्ण a. warm from a cow (as milk). --गृहं a bathroom with water-jets, a shower-bath or a house furnished with artificial jets or fountains of water; R. 16. 49. --धरः {1} holder of streams, a cloud. {2} a sword. --निपातः, --पातः {1} a fall of rain, a hard or pelting shower; Me. 48. {2} a stream of water. --यंत्रं a fountain, jet (of water); Amaru. 59; Ratn. 1. 12. --वर्षः, र्षं--, संपातः a hard, sharp-driving or incessant, shower; R. 4. 82. --बाहिन् a. incessant, continuous; U. 4. 3. --विषः a crooked sword.

a: धारणा — 1 The act of holding, bearing, supporting preserving, &c. --2 The faculty of retaining in the mind, a good or retentive memory; धीर्धारणावती मेधा Mk. --3 Memory in general. --4 Keeping the mind collected, holding the breath suspended, steady abstraction of mind; परिचेतुमुपांशु धारणां R. 8. 18; Ms. 6. 72; Y. 3. 201; (धारणेत्युच्यते चेयं धार्यते यन्मनो तया). --5 Fortitude, firmness, steadiness. --6 A fixed precept or injunction, a settled rule, conclusion; इति धर्मस्य धारणा Ms. 8. 184, 4. 38, 9. 124. --7 Understanding, intellect. --8 Continuance in rectitude, propriety, decorum. --9 Conviction or abstraction. --Comp. --योगः deep devotion. --शक्तिः f. a retentive memory.

DAraRAsvarUpaBedAdikamanyaToktaM yaTA agniruvAca “DAraRA manasoDyeye saMsTitiDyanivaddviDA । mUrttAmUrttahariDyAnaM manoDAraRato harO । yadbAhyAvasTitaM lakzyaM tasmAnna calate manaH । tAvat kAlaM a: धारण — a. (णी f.) [धृ-णिच्-ल्युट्] Holding, bearing, carrying, preserving, sustaining, protecting, having, assuming, &c. --णौ (du.) The two female breasts. --णं 1 The act of holding, bearing, supporting, preserving or keeping back. --2 Possessing, possession. --3 Observing; holding fast. --4 Retaining in the memory; ग्रहणधारणपटुर्बालकः. --5 Being indebted (to any one.) --6 Steady abstraction of the mind. --7 Keeping, maintaining. --8 Restraining. --9 (In gram.) Pronouncing imperfectly, --णी 1 A row or line. --2 A vein or tubular vessel. --3 Steadiness.

s: puM, (Darati jalAdikamiti । Df + Rvul .) kalasaH । tasyotpattyAdi yaTA, -- brahmovAca । “utpattiM lakzaRaM mAnaM kaTayAmi mahAmune ! । DArakAH kalasAScEva yena loke prakIrttitAH ॥ amfte maTyamAne tu sarvvadevEH sadAnavEH । manTAnaM mandaraM kftvA netraM kftvA tu vAsukim ॥ utpannamamftaM tatra mahAvIryyaparAkramam । tasyAyaM DAraRArTAya kalasaH parikIrttritaH ॥ kalAM kalAM gfhItvA vE devAnAM viSvakarmmaRA । nirmmito'yaM surEryasmAt kalasastena ucyate ॥ kalasasya muKe brahmA grIvAyAntu maheSvaraH । mUle tu saMsTito vizRurmaDye mAtfgaRAH sTitAH ॥ SezAstu devatAH sarvvA vezwayanti caturddiSam । kukzO tu sAgarAH sapta sapta dbIpAstu saMSritAH ॥ nakzatrARi grahAH sarvve taTEva kulaparvvatAH । himavAn hemakUwaSca nizaDo merureva ca ॥ rohito mAlyavantaSca sUryyakAntiSca parvvatAH । gaNgA sarasvatI sinDuH suBagA yamunA nadI ॥ ErAvatI SatahradA taTA vEtaraRI nadI । godAvarI narmmadA ca mahI nAma mahAnadI ॥ kurukzetraM prayAgaSca ekahaMsaM pfTUdakam । amareSvaraH puRqarIkaM gaNgAsAgara eva ca ॥ pfTivyAM yAni tIrTAni kalase nivasanti te । grahAH SAntiSca puzwiSca prItirgAyattrireva ca ॥ fgvedo'Ta yajurvvedaH sAmavedastaTEva ca । aTarvvavedasahitAH sarvve kalasasaMsTitAH ॥ navEva kalasAH puRyAH SamBumUrttisamudBavAH । goByopagoByo marutaH svasvadaSca taTA paraH ॥ manoharaH KalurBadraH paYcamaH parikIrttitaH । virajastanudUzaSca zazWasaptamakAvuBO ॥ azwamastvindriyopeto navamo vijayaH smftaH । navEva kalasAH KyAtA aDidevaM niboData ॥ SfRu vatsa ! yaTA tezAM diSAM nyAso vyavasTitaH । navamo yaH samAKyAto vijayo nAma nAmataH ॥ Sivastatra sTitaH sAkzAt sarvvapApaharaH SuBaH । kzitIndro jyezWakalaso dbitIyo jalasamBavaH ॥ tftIyaH pavanaScEva caturTastu hutASanaH । paYcamo yajamAnastu zazWastvAkASasamBavaH ॥ somastu saptamaH prokta AdityaSca taTAzwamaH । ete cotpAditA devyA SivenADizWitAH purA ॥ indrasya mUrttayaScAzwO sUryyAntA navamaH SivaH । kzitIndraH pUrvvato nyAsyaH paScime jalasamBavaH ॥ vAyavye vAyavo nyAsya Agneye agnisamBavaH । nErfte yajamAnastu ESAnyAkASasamBavaH ॥ sOmyamuttarato yojyaM sOraM dakziRato nyaset । nyasyEvaM kalasAnAntu pUrvvarUpaM vicintayet ॥ kalasAnAM muKe brahmA grIvAyAM vizRureva hi । maDye mAtfgaRAH sarvve sendrA devASca pannagAH ॥ kukzO tu sAgarAstezAM saptadbIpA ca medinI । SriyA cEva taTomA ca ganDarvvA fzayastaTA ॥ paYcaBUtAstaTA DArAstezAmavakftAH sTitAH । pUrRAH pUtena toyena sidDAstvekAntato mune ! ॥ saritsaraHsaKAtena taqAgena jalena vA । vApIkUpoQadivyena sAmudreRa suKAvahAH ॥ sarvvamaNgalamANgalyAH sarvvakilvizanASakAH । aBizeke sadA grAhyAH kalasA IdfSAH SuBAH ॥ yAtrAvivAhakAle vA pratizWAyajYakarmmaRi । yojanIyA viSezeRa sarvvakAmaprasADakAH ॥ grahAn DArayate yasmAnmAtarA viviDAstaTA । duritAMSca mahADorAMstena te DArakAH smftAH ॥ ekEkAntu kalAM mUrttO kzityAdInAM yaTAkramam । saMhftya saMsTitA yasmAttena te kalasAH smftAH ॥ hEmarAjatatAmrA vA mfRmayA lakzaRAnvitAH । paYcamANgulavEpulyamutseDaH zoqaSANgulaH ॥ kalasAnAM pramARantu muKamazwANgulaM Bavet ॥” iti devIpurARam ॥ DAraRakarttari, tri ॥ (yaTA, paYcatantre । 2 । 175 । “apriyARyapi paTyAni ye vadanti nfRAmiha । ta eva suhfdaH proktA anye syurnAmaDArakAH ॥”)

a: धातुः — [धा-आधारे तुन्] 1 A constituent or essential part, an ingredient. --2 An element, primary or elementary substance, i. e. पृथिवी, अप्, तेजस्, वायु and आकाश. --3 A secretion, primary fluid or juice, essential ingredient of the body (which are considered to be 7: --रसासृङ्मांसमेदोऽस्थिमज्जाशुक्राणि धातवः, or sometimes ten if केश, त्वच् and स्नायु be added). --4 A humour or affection of the body, (i. e. वात, पित्त and कफ). --5 A mineral, metal, metallic ore; न्यस्ताक्षरा धातुरसेन यत्र Ku. 1. 7; त्वामालिख्य प्रणयकुपितां धातुरागैः शिलायां Me. 105; R. 4. 71; Ku. 6. 51. --6 A verbal root; भूवादयो धातवः P. I. 3. 1; पश्चादध्ययनार्थस्य धातोरधिरिवाभवत् R. 15. 9. --7 The soul. --8 The Supreme Spirit. --9 An organ of sense. --10 Any one of the properties of the five elements, i. e. रूप, रस, गंध, स्पर्श; and शब्द. --11 A bone. --12 A part, portion. --13 A fluid mineral of a red colour. --14 Ved. A supporter. --15 Anything to be drunk, as milk &c. --f. A milch cow. --Comp. --उपलः chalk. --काशीशं, --कासीसं red sulphate of iron. --कुशल a. skilful in working in metals. --क्रिया metallurgy, mineralogy. --क्षयः waste of the bodily humours, a wasting disease, a kind of consumption. --ग्राहिन् m. calamine. --घ्नं, --नाशनं sour gruel (prepared from the fermentation of rice-water). --जं bitumen --द्रावकः borax. --पः the alimentary juice, the chief of the seven essential ingredients of the body. --पाठः a list of roots arranged according to Pāṇini's grammatical system; (the most important of these lists called धातुपाठ being supposed to be the work of Pāṇini himself, as supplementary to his Sūtras). --पुष्टिः f. nutrition of the bodily humours. --भृत् m. a mountain. --मलं {1} impure excretion of the essential fluids of the body. {2} lead. --माक्षिकं {1} sulphuret of iron. {2} a mineral substance. --मारिन्. m. sulphur. --रसः a mineral or metallic fluid; Ku. 1. 7. --राजकः --कं semen. --वल्लभं borax. --वादः mineralogy, metallurgy. --वादिन् m. a mineralogist. --विष् f. lead. --वैरिन् m. sulphur. --शेखरं green sulphate of iron, green vitriol. --शोधनं, --संभवं lead. --साम्यं good health, (equilibrium of the three humours). --हन् m. sulphur.

1. धाव् cl. 1. P. Ā. धावति, ˚ते (pf. दधाव, ˚वे Gr.; aor. अदधावत्, RV.; अधावीत्, Br.; Prec. धाव्यासम् Gr.; fut. धाविष्यति, Kāv., ˚ते and धाविता Gr.; ind.p. धावित्वा and ˚व्य, Kāv.; धौत्वा Gr.); to run, flow, stream, move, glide, swim, RV. &c. &c.; to run after (with or scil. पश्चात्), Mn.; MBh. &c. = seek for (acc.), Kir. ii, 29; run towards (अभिमुखम्), Hit. run a race (आजिम्), Br., run as fast as possible (सर्वं जवम्), ib.; run to and fro (इतश् चेतश् च), MBh.; Hit.; run away, flee, RV.; AV.; to advance or rush against (acc.), MBh.; R.; (प्रति), Kathās. : Caus. धावयति (aor. अदीधवत् Gr.) to make run, impel, Pañc.; to drive in a chariot, (with instr. of the vehicle and acc. of the way), Br.; to jump, dance, RV. x, 146, 2. (cf. √ 2. धन्, धन्व्, धव्; 1. धू.)

2. धाव् cl. 1. P. Ā. धावति, ˚ते (pf. दधाव, Bhaṭṭ.; aor. -अधाविष्ट, RV. ix, 70, 8; ind.p. धौत्वा, Prab. iv, 23 [v.l. धूत्वा] and -धाव्य, Kauś.) to rinse, cleanse, wash, purify, polish, make bright (Ā. also to rub one's self with, rub into one's own person), RV. &c. &c.: Pass. धाव्यते (pf. 3. pl. -दधाविरे), Śiś. : Caus. धावयति, ˚ते, to cleanse, wash, Br.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; cause to be washed, L. : Desid. दिधाविषति, ˚ते; Intens. दाधाव्यते Gr.
a: धाव् — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (धावति, धावित) 1 (a) To run, advance; अद्यापि धावति मनः Ch. P. 36; धावंत्यमी मृगजवाक्षमयेव रथ्याः Ś. 1. 8; गच्छति पुरः शरीरं धावति पश्चादसंस्तुंतं चेतः 1. 34. (b) To move, glide. --2 To run towards, advance against, assault, encounter; Bk. 16. 67. --3 To flow, stream or flow forth; धावत्यंभसि तैलवत् Suśr. --4 To run or flee away. --5 To give milk (as a cow). {vII.v} {c1c} U. (धावति-ते, धौत or धावित) 1 To wash, clean, cleanse, purify, rub off; दधाबाद्भिस्ततश्चक्षुः सुग्रीवस्य बिभीषणः विदांचकार धौताक्षः स रिपुं खे ननर्द च .. Bk. 14. 50, Ś. 6. 24; Śi. 17. 8. --2 To brighten, polish. --3 To rub into one's person (Atm.).
